name: server-only
description: No-op test stub for the `server-only` guard. Next.js aliases the real package to its own compiled react-server stub at build time, so production behaviour is untouched; this local link only exists so `bun test` (which resolves node_modules directly and does not apply the react-server condition) can import server-tagged modules. The published server-only@0.0.1 throws on any non-react-server import, which would break the API tests.
